# Order Objects

Order Objects is an open-source Blender add-on for renaming selected objects in selection order.

## Installation (Blender 4.x)

1. Open Blender.
2. Go to `Edit > Preferences > Add-ons`.
3. Click `Install...` and select the release ZIP.
4. Enable `Order_objects` in the add-ons list.
